MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVTIES COMMISSION MEETING
  AUGUST 21, 2017

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called
  to order at 6:31 p.m. at the City of Rolling Hills Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North,
  Rolling Hills Estates, California by CHAIR ROMANELLI.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIRMAN ROMANELLI led those in attendance in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT: Chair Romanelli, Giglia, Retz, Wroan, Portugal, Persichina

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Pope

  STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF JULY 17, 2017

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ

  TO APPROVE THE CORRECTED PARK & ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES OF JULY 17,
  2017.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  NONE

  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A. STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION FUNDING REQUEST

  Director Clark provided the Park and Activities Commission with a brief summary of the request by The
  Terraces Homeowners Association. He stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities
  Commission approve The Terraces Homeowners Association request of $2,500 in matching funds from the
  City’s street entryway beautification program in FY 2017-18.

  In a question by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI, Richard Yee, Director of Maintenance, The Terraces
  HOA, stated that there is no additional concern with funding of the project; the project is being funded by
  the dues collected from property owners.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ inquired about the total budget for the City’s street entryway program. Director
  Clark stated that City Council approved $10K for FY 2017-18.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL,

  TO APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION THAT THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES
  COMMISSION TO APPROVE THE TERRACES HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION REQUEST OF
  $2,500 IN MATCHING FUNDS FROM THE CITY’S STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION
  PROGRAM IN FY 2017-18.

  AYES:  Chair Romanelli, Giglia, Retz, Wroan, Portugal, Persichina
  NAYES:
  ABSENT:  Pope
  ABSTAIN:

  B. PARADE OF LIGHTS MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT

  Director Clark provided the Park and Activities Commission with a brief summary of the proposed
  agreement. He stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities make a recommendation to City

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING  1
MINUTES
AUGUST 21, 2017
   Council to enter into an Agreement with Pageantry Productions to provide parade management services
  for the Peninsula Holiday Parade of Lights on December 2, 2017.

  In a question by CHAIR ROMANELLI, Director Clark stated that there is a typo in the agreement with regard
  to the having judges; having judges is optional for this agreement. He added that having judges contributes
  to the number and quality of entries since pageant scores are important to participants.

  In a question by COMMISSIONER WROAN, Director Clark stated that the parade always has judges and
  not having them may impact the number of entries.

  Commissioner Portugal stated that there is a discrepancy in Exhibit B-2 of the agreement, the amount
  should be $9,250.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA,

  TO MAKE A RECOMMENDATION TO CITY COUNCIL TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT,
  WHICH WILL REFLECT THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CORRECTIONS, WITH PAGEANTRY
  PRODUECTION TO PROVIDE PARADE MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR THE PENINSULA
  HOLIDAY PARADE OF LIGHTS ON DECEMBER 2, 2017. THE DECISION TO HAVE JUDGES
  WILL BE DEFERRED TO THE PARADE SUBCOMMITTEE.

  AYES:  Chair Romanelli, Giglia, Retz, Wroan, Portugal, Persichina
  NAYES:
  ABSENT:  Pope
  ABSTAIN:

  C. POTENTIAL NEW POCKET PARK

  Director Clark provided a brief overview on this item. He stated that the Harbor Site Homeowners
  Association polled neighbors who are all in favor of this project.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that this is an interesting location and has the potential of being used as
  a nature preserve. The site has a narrow path that is being used as a horse trail.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ suggested creating a pathway to connect the City’s right-of-way from the location
  to the Nature Center. He also thought there was an opportunity for a scenic view of the L.A. Harbor.

  Andrea Vona, Executive Director, PVP Land Conservancy, stated that there is a person who lives near this
  location who would like to donate the funds for this project. Some of the things suggested are clearing the
  brush, adding sitting area(s) and flattening and widening the trail.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ,

  TO DIRECT STAFF TO EVALUATE THE INFORMATION RECEIVED AND MAKE A
  RECOMMENDATION TO THE PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION AT A FUTURE MEETING.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR ROMANELLI SO ORDERED.

  D. SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE PROPOSED JUNIOR LEAGUE

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA provided background on the dissolution of the Peninsula Pony League
  and stated that a new Junior League is proposed to be formed and the use of Ernie Howlett Park and a
  park in a neighboring city is large enough to host the league.

  Jill Trimingham, Resident, stated that she is the mother of middle school children who would like to play
  baseball and have “aged-out” of the Little League age. She is in support of forming a Junior League and
  would like to be more involved to participate as a board member, which is something she stated she could
  not do with the Rolling Hills League.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that a baseline needs to be established as well as explanation of
  recent and past issues and a recommendation is needed in order to provide further direction on this item.

  COMMISSION ITEMS (VERBAL REPORT)

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORTS

  COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that at Dapplegray Park one of the one 3-rail posts near the port-o-potty
  has been kicked in and needs to be repaired.

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING  2
MINUTES
AUGUST 21, 2017
   COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA inquired about lights at Ernie Howlett Park. Director Clark stated that
  lights will be installed and will be turned on from dusk to dawn.

  CHAIR ROMANELLI stated that at Rockbluff Park the drinking fountain is constantly being clogged with
  sand and the recycle bins are overflowing with alcoholic beverages.

  DIRECTOR’S ITEMS

  A. CITY CELEBRATION SIGN-UP BOOTH

  Director Clark passed around a sign-up sheet with volunteer options for the City Celebration event.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that four food trucks have been confirmed for this event. In addition, the
  total cost of rental equipment for the event is under $1K.

  TOURS OF PEPPERWOOD, CHANDLER, SILVER SPUR, AND ROCKBLUFF PARKS

  PEPPERWOOD PARK - Items noted for repair or replacement

  •  Pick-up fallen plank of 3-rail fence left of the park path.
  •  Branch on top of pergola
  •  Remove dead wood from ash tree
  •  Contact Bennett Landscaping to clear weeds
  •  Walk way paver is out of place
  •  Tripping hazard between dirt pathway and cement walk-way

  CHANDLER PARK – Items noted for repair or replacement

  •  Dead tree south of entrance to the park
  •  Tree branches need to be raised (trimmed)
  •  Broken/leaning fence posts on south side of park near picnic bench
  •  Large hole on south side of park near picnic bench
  •  Gate leading to horse arena is off hinge

  SILVER SPUR PARK

  •  Memorial tree planted needs to be replaced
  •  Fence on west wide needs repair
  •  Top shrubs (trim)
  •  Refinish park bench
  •  Carrotwood tree branches fallen
  •  Street sign at Silver Spur and Latigo is loose

  ROCKBLUFF PARK

  •  “No Parking” sign is bent
  •  Loose fence board up the hill on west side
  •  An additional “pooper scooper” station is needed at bottom of hill

  OTHER

  •  Trash enclosure wall deteriorating at City Hall near PVDN entrance

  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR ROMANELLI adjourned the meeting at 7:38 p.m. to the adjourned Park & Activities Commission
  Meeting of September 18, 2017 at 6:00 p.m. at the Rolling Hills Little League Concession Area, 3011 Palos
  Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  Carol Corea  Douglas R. Prichard
  Minutes Secretary  City Clerk
